# HigherMindAI

> I find what is costing a local business its calls, fix it in order, and only then turn on the
> ads. Local SEO and Google Business Profile ranking, Facebook and Instagram kept current, a desk
> that answers when the owner cannot, every call and form counted, and websites built around how
> customers buy. For trades, auto parts and recyclers, and auto service and collision shops.
> Solo operator, based in Erin, Ontario, Canada. Veteran-owned.

Operator: Derek Train, Erin, Ontario, Canada. Phone 647-242-5800. Email highermindai@gmail.com.
Hours: Monday to Friday 7am-8pm, Saturday 9am-2pm (Eastern). Take the nine minutes: https://highermindai.com/book/

## How it works - three steps, in order

A buyer is not shown a menu. He is shown three steps in a fixed order and asked which one fits.
Most businesses start on the Foundation.

- [The Read](https://highermindai.com/the-read/) - the way in. Everything a business has online, gone through properly in a week. What is wrong, what it costs, and a fixed price on the right step. Three real findings or it is free; the fee comes off whichever step is chosen within thirty days.
- [The Pin](https://highermindai.com/how-it-works/#the-pin) - step one. Found, and held. The Google Business Profile rebuilt against the businesses above it, then held. Every review answered. Where the business started, recorded before anything is touched.
- [The Foundation](https://highermindai.com/how-it-works/#the-foundation) - step two, where most start. Found, trusted, answered, measured. Everything in the Pin, plus Facebook and Instagram kept current from the owner's own job photos, a desk that answers when the owner cannot (web or phone line), and every call and form counted.
- [The Storefront](https://highermindai.com/how-it-works/#the-storefront) - step three. The Foundation, and a website built around how customers buy and how the owner actually closes. Hosted and cared for.
- [The Tap](https://highermindai.com/how-it-works/#the-tap) - last, always. Paid campaigns on the client's own accounts, spend on the client's own card, paid on what it sells. Never before the profile and the site are right.
- [After you have chosen](https://highermindai.com/how-it-works/#after): more cities, getting named by assistants, extra social surfaces, custom systems. Add-ons after the choice, never the menu.

The only outcome promise is the Rank Lock: first page on the agreed term inside sixty days - ninety in the hardest markets - or the monthly pauses until it lands. The desk carries the Launch Lock: live in 14 days on the web and 21 on the phone, counted from the last thing needed from the client.

- [Trades](https://highermindai.com/trades/): plumbing, heating and cooling, electrical, roofing, concrete, landscaping, septic, painting. Usually lands on the Foundation.

- [Auto service and collision](https://highermindai.com/auto-service-collision/): usually lands on the Foundation.

## Selected work

- [Work](https://highermindai.com/work/): an auto parts business in Brampton whose site was a phone number and an address now runs a part matcher on year, make, model and trim, a page for each vehicle it stocks for, and a request that reaches the counter by text already carrying everything needed to quote it. Described as a build; no results are claimed.
- [Bubbles Window Cleaning](https://bubblescleaningservices.com/): a window and eavestrough cleaner in East York, Toronto, rebuilt with a price guide set out by storey, a three-step quote builder that sends by text, and a page for each neighbourhood it serves. Described as a build.

## Boundaries

- [Where the desk stops](https://highermindai.com/scope-limits/): administrative intake only. It never quotes a price, never commits a crew, never gives advice reserved to a licensed person and never states what insurance covers.
- [About](https://highermindai.com/about/): Derek Train - law enforcement and Canadian Armed Forces background; built and lost a produce delivery business that had no owned way of being found, which is why the order is found first, answered second, ads last.
